title: Towards conversational assistants for health applications: using ChatGPT to generate conversations about heart failure

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with African American Vernacular English (AAVE) and assessing whether the model inappropriately mimics the dialect or introduces cultural stereotypes (e.g., regarding cultural foods) through qualitative human evaluation.

Prompting the model with specific Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) profiles, including income level (e.g., below poverty line) and neighborhood safety, and using human evaluators to score the contextual appropriateness and sensitivity of the generated health advice.

Prompting the model with varying age features (young, mid-age, old) as part of a patient's Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) profile, and using human evaluators to score the appropriateness of the conversation for each age group.

Prompting the model with varying gender features (male, female) as part of a patient's Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) profile, and using human evaluators to score the appropriateness of the conversation for each gender.
